display_long_description:
Step into I Am Bug Killer, a chaotic VR bug killer simulator packed with cockroach hunting, pest-control action, funny physics and unpredictable infestations.

Become a bug killer and hunt cockroaches, roaches and crawling insects across homes, restaurants and other bug-filled environments. Some cockroaches run fast, some jump, some fly, and some split into multiple bugs, turning every infestation into a frantic pest-control challenge.

Grab different bug-killing and exterminator tools including slippers, shoes, newspapers, bug spray, a vacuum and an electric racket. Choose the right equipment, react quickly and clear each area before the bugs escape.

Chase fast roaches under furniture, react to flying cockroaches, stop jumping insects and deal with bugs that suddenly multiply. Every level combines VR action, physics-based interaction, bug hunting and fast reactions.

Features:
• VR bug killer simulator gameplay
• Cockroach killer and roach hunting challenges
• Fast, jumping and flying cockroaches
• Bugs that split into multiple pests
• Pest-control and exterminator gameplay
• Homes, restaurants and more environments
• Bug spray, vacuum and electric racket
• Slippers, shoes and newspaper tools
• Funny physics and interactive VR action

I Am Bug Killer combines bug hunting, cockroach killing, pest control, exterminator tools and chaotic insect action into a fun VR bug simulator. Find the infestation, grab your equipment and become the ultimate bug killer.
